_comment: Project settings for fourwise. CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL is the hard quota guard: it sits above per-invocation and frontmatter values, so NO subagent can reach Fable (or Opus) regardless of its file. It is baked into the session env at launch — editing this file mid-session does NOT lift it, which also means it cannot be accidentally lifted. Leave it set permanently. The one sanctioned exception (design-lead on Opus) runs headless: claude -p --model opus. See docs/ORCHESTRATION.md.
